<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
 The PKGBUILD sets pkgver and defines source URLs pointing to the upstream GitHub repository and its releases. The source entries use the standard :: notation to fetch files over HTTPS from github.com, which is the project's own upstream. No top-level code, pkgver() function, or other commands execute during the fetch and parse phase; the only code run is variable assignment. The sha256sums are provided for each source, so any downloaded archive will be verified against those checksums. There are no eval, base64, curl|bash, or other dangerous patterns. Consequently, running makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare and makepkg --printsrcinfo only downloads and extracts the declared sources and prints source information; it does not execute any arbitrary code or exfiltrate data.
</details>
<evidence>

Safe: only standard source fetches, no malicious code
</summary>
